ceiling_directive: Prove a quantitative protected-cube inverse yielding an explicit O(r_n) band-width bound and complete the fixed-nuisance Bernoulli construction needed for the matching all-band converse.
improvement_directive: Establish an explicit O(r_n) modulus for the probability and marked-channel sieve, then resolve the fixed-nuisance Bernoulli packet to obtain the corresponding unconditional lower bound. Also state primitive compatibility conditions and exhibit a full causal law proving that the indexed class is nonempty.
critique: The note proves identification of f_x, q_x, and the ADRF, plus abstract exact-class and semi-infinite finite-sieve bands with uniform honesty and only o(1) expected maximal width. It does not prove the advertised candidate r_n rate or any unconditional converse: the all-band lower bound is conditional on the unresolved fixed-nuisance-marked-modulus question and therefore contributes no delivered rate result. Neither band is a certified finite algorithm, and the package provides no computation demonstrating that the profiled sets are practically usable. Nonemptiness is also not established for the stated range of class constants—choices such as κ|I|>1 make the class empty—and the proof expressly permits vacuous coverage when the projected class is empty. The framing accurately discloses the missing rate, but the marked extension of known cocycle identification together with qualitative compactness-based inference is too incremental and nonoperational for the field tier, which also limits the projected paper score. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.6 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
